organizationId.description: Required when providerType=ORGANIZATION; forbidden when INDIVIDUAL (user_id derives from the JWT).

serviceBaseLocation.description: GeoJSON Point — coordinates are [longitude, latitude] (NOT lat,lng!).

serviceRadiusKm.description: Primary service radius in km; 0 = coverage by named zones only.

displayName.description: Public name: business_name, falling back to organization.display_name.

serviceRadiusKm.description: Primary service radius in km (0 = zone-only coverage).

distanceMeters.description: Distance from the provider base to the client, in metres (rounded).

categoryVerificationStatus.description: VERIFIED (Hard Trust) | NOT_REQUIRED (Social Trust) for the requested category.

businessName.description: Resolved business name (falls back to organization.display_name for ORGANIZATION providers).

zonePolygon.description: GeoJSON Polygon — rings of [longitude, latitude] positions, first === last (closed). NOT lat,lng!
GeoJSON Polygon — coordinates are [longitude, latitude], rings closed.

serviceCategoryId.description: UUID of the service category to add

isActive.description: Pause or resume this category for the provider

priceAmount.description: Required for FLAT/HOURLY, must be absent for QUOTE_ONLY. Minimum 0.
Required for FLAT/HOURLY, must be absent for QUOTE_ONLY. Minimum 0.

downloadUrl.description: Relative download endpoint for the stored file

rejectionReason.description: Reason shown to the provider for the rejection

serviceItemId.description: Required for DIRECT_BOOKING, optional for PROJECT_TENDER (open tender).

requestedServiceProviderId.description: Required for DIRECT_BOOKING (the specific Pro the client targets). Must be absent for PROJECT_TENDER.

estimatedCurrency.description: ISO 4217 currency. Required when estimatedAmount is set.

reason.description: Optional reason for declining the request

fileUrl.description: Relative storage key for the stored file

serviceItemNameTranslations.description: Libellés i18n du service (nullable pour un tender ouvert)

stripePaymentMethodId.description: Stripe PaymentMethod id (pm_...) created client-side (e.g. via Stripe Elements, or a test token like pm_card_visa).

setDefault.description: Make this the default method. The first method saved is always default regardless.

deletedAtUtc.description: Set when the method has been removed.

amount.description: Refund amount in the payment currency (major units, e.g. 25.00). Must not exceed the still-refundable balance of the payment.

reason.description: Reason for the refund (admin audit trail).

expiresAt.description: Expiry of the onboarding link (Account Links are short-lived).

requirementsCurrentlyDue.description: Snapshot of Stripe's requirements.currently_due field keys.

onboardedAtUtc.description: First time the account became VERIFIED.

description.description: The Pro's pitch / scope of the quote.

validUntilUtc.description: Quote expiration (ISO 8601, timestamptz). Must be in the future.

amount.description: Decimal serialized as string, paired with currency.
